OVERTURE manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C for 7 h.

ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
Page: 190-230 C, 50-70 C, 60-300 mm/s, fan on (FAQ: full fan). '0.4 mm Hardened Nozzle Recommended'; 'slightly more abrasive than standard PLA, but still safe for most standard setups'. Overture's 'Wood Series' colors (Cheesewood, Walnut, Jarrah, White Oak) are Rock PLA with marble dust, no wood fill. 'Rock PLA Gradient' identical. Density not published (no TDS listed).
